scenicChapters.title: Seven Lakes Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 53 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

road-route-of-the-seven-lakes.story: A 192 km round trip from San Martín de los Andes - roughly 3 h 12 in the saddle. On the way it passes Lago Falkner, Lago Espejo, Villa La Angostura and back through Lago Espejo. The highest point is about 1,400 m.
